mentions.name: Gossip
mentions.description: Media insights platform positioned against Meltwater and Brandwatch that uses large volumes of AI processing to extract data traditional media monitoring players cannot, providing competitor benchmarking, tracking of impactful discussions, and actionable brand insights. First version launching to pilot customers in August.
mentions.problem: Traditional media monitoring companies cannot extract the data this platform provides.
mentions.audience: Pilot customers launching in August; companies currently using big media monitoring companies.
mentions.source_excerpt: We are working on Gossip: the future of media insights (think Meltwater, Brandwatch, etc).

evidence.value: We are working on Gossip: the future of media insights (think Meltwater, Brandwatch, etc).
